visual_acceptance: Player City Progression Sheet v1 must resolve into exactly six coherent spatially separated city-stage pieces in stable top-to-bottom, left-to-right sheet order: early camp, timber settlement, fortified timber town, early stone city, mature stone castle-city, and advanced capital. PASS requires each extracted piece to read as one coherent standalone settlement at official review cameras, preserve its progression identity and major silhouette, retain usable materials/UV/normals/collider, and show no cross-stage fused geometry, remote floating fragments, catastrophic missing walls/buildings, or unusable side/rear geometry. Technical separation alone is insufficient.
notes: First zero-credit Blender/Unity gate of the exact Tripo generation exported 2026-09-30. Source GLB 70,126,968 bytes / SHA-256 206b7586933fa16e1367b9bdd68147f7525fe7741c25795437693b5688100d8a. Generation consumed the one explicitly requested 55-credit H3.1 run. This gate spends no additional Tripo credits and does not touch Valoria production/gameplay. Six-stage sheet gets a higher 149.4K combined validation budget (~24.9K average per stage) rather than forcing the legacy 49.8K single-module profile.
